ev.s: Test day in Japan and overseas. Your admission voucher (受験票) shows the time and place. Results come online about two months later (usually late January).

ev.t: 第39回 介護福祉士国家試験 (Care Worker national exam)
ev.s: Written exam for the 介護福祉士 national licence. Check your 受験票 and test place.

open.t: JFT-Basic (Japan Foundation Test for Basic Japanese)
open.s: Computer test (CBT) held many times a year in Japan and abroad. Book a date on the official test site.
Computer test (CBT) at Pearson VUE test centers. Booking is open now; choose a free date.

open.t: 介護技能評価試験 / 介護日本語評価試験 (Specified Skilled Worker, nursing care)
open.s: Computer tests for the 特定技能 介護 visa, held often in Japan and abroad (Prometric).

open.t: 外食業 / 飲食料品製造業 特定技能 tests (Food service & food manufacturing)
open.s: Skill tests for the 特定技能 food visas, held many times a year in Japan and abroad. See the official Ministry of Agriculture page for test info.

news.t: New 育成就労 (Employment for Skill Development) system starts
news.s: It replaces the Technical Intern Training (技能実習) system. Workers can change jobs under set rules and aim for 特定技能.
